description: Mercury business-banking connector (read-only). Surfaces the user's bank accounts as `mercury:account` items in the local index — account name, status (active/archived), type/kind (checking/savings), the last 4 digits of the account number (the full number is never stored), routing number, available + current USD balances, the legal business name, and the open date. Useful for answering banking questions ("what's my checking balance?", "which accounts are archived?") without leaving Nimbus. Bearer API-token auth. The SaaS host (api.mercury.com) is fixed. Mercury balances are USD major units (dollars, not cents) and `createdAt` is ISO-8601 (converted to epoch-ms on index). Transactions / bills / statements and the wire / ACH (HITL) writes are deferred follow-ups.
author: Nimbus
